finalPrompt:
Create a readable Korean TripLOG “상세 일정” report mockup using a straightforward table. Show one complete A4 portrait page, 210 × 297 mm, equivalent to approximately 794 × 1123 CSS pixels. Retain the existing white paper, dark navy text, subtle pale blue accents and Korean typography.

Use a compact header with “TripLOG”, “순천의 사흘”, “2026.10.09 – 10.11 · 2명” and “상세 일정”.

The main content must be one continuous four-column table with these exact headings: “날짜”, “시간”, “장소·이동”, “메모”. Allocate approximately 12%, 17%, 42% and 29% of the table width. Use a lightly shaded header, fine horizontal and vertical grid lines, comfortable cell padding and a slightly stronger divider between days. Merge the date cells across the three rows of each day. Keep all four columns consistently aligned throughout the table.

Use one row per stop. Make the place name bold and larger than its address. Place the address beneath it in smaller, quieter text, followed by a compact plain-text travel line where provided. Give the memo its own ordinary table cell. Display time ranges clearly in the time column. Target 15px place names, 14px times and 13px supporting text at the reference page size. Fit all nine rows legibly on one page. This is a simple report table: no timeline, connected dots, cards, illustrations, oversized icons, decorative slogans or memo callout boxes.
